title: A pizza builder
description:
Write `class Pizza` with a static nested `Builder`:

- `Pizza.builder(String size)` starts a builder; size must be `"small"`, `"medium"` or `"large"` (otherwise `IllegalArgumentException`).
- `topping(String t)` adds a topping (adding the same one twice keeps one), `extraCheese()` sets extra cheese; both return the builder.
- `build()` returns an immutable `Pizza`.
- `Pizza` has `size()`, `toppings()` (an unmodifiable list in the order added), `extraCheese()` and `price()`: small 800, medium 1000, large 1200 cents, plus 150 per topping and 100 for extra cheese.
- `toString()` gives `"medium: ham, olives + extra cheese"` (no toppings: `"small: plain"`; the `" + extra cheese"` part only when set).
hints: The `Pizza` constructor is private and takes the builder; `build()` is the only way to call it. `List.copyOf` makes an unmodifiable copy, so later changes to the builder cannot reach a finished pizza.
